name: PdxToggle
description: A button the user presses on and off, its state exposed with `aria-pressed`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: size
members.description: Size of the control (e.g. sm, md, lg).

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: The toggle's name when its content does not say it ("B" is Bold), forwarded to the inner `<button>`: `aria-label` on the host has no role to name.

members.name: radio
members.description:
Set by a `pdx-toggle-group type="single"` on its toggles: the button is a `radio` with
`aria-checked` in the group's `radiogroup`, instead of a toggle button with `aria-pressed`.
Not for a toggle on its own: a radio belongs in a radiogroup.

events.name: pressed-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `pressed`. Does not bubble.
